name: Chimps Nightmare
summary:
Chimp’s Nightmare is a VR horror-themed movement game where you swing, crawl, and panic-run through dark underground tunnels. The only way out… is to survive the nightmare.

No sticks. No buttons. Just your hands—and the fear chasing you through dimly-lit caverns and cryptic arenas. Play tag, explore eerie maps, or confront your fears with friends.
